name: Color Palette
description: Generate harmonious color palettes from a single color. Export formats for design tools and code.
longDescription: Color Palette helps designers create beautiful, accessible color schemes. Input a base color to generate complementary, analogous, triadic, and monochromatic palettes. Checks WCAG contrast ratios for accessibility. Export as CSS variables, Tailwind config, Figma JSON, Adobe ASE, and more. Save and share palettes with teams.
pricingDetails: Pro: $3/month for unlimited palettes, advanced exports, team sharing, accessibility checks. Free trial available.
features: Export: CSS, Tailwind, Figma, Adobe ASE
